title: BEAVERTAILS: Towards Improved Safety Alignment of LLM via a Human-Preference Dataset
reasoning: The paper introduces a dataset and framework for evaluating LLM safety alignment. Harmlessness is explicitly defined based on "ethical considerations and safety implications" (Sec 3.4). It also includes harm categories like "Non-Violent Unethical Behavior" and "Misinformation Re. ethics, laws, and safety" (Appendix B), which directly involve the evaluation of ethical principles and moral judgments within its core assessment methodology.
